purpose: lekhāpanāt puṇyam upārjitaṃ yat tenāstu loko khilakośapūrṇo buddho yathādhīdhanakośapūrṇaḥ (merit transfer for the enlightenment of all beings, including mother and teachers)
notes: The commissioner is anonymous (referred to only as 'mama' in the verse describing the commissioning of the copy: 'kośasya ṭīkāṃ vimalāṃ sphuṭārthāṃ lekhāpanāt puṇyam upārjitaṃ yat').
